answer_1.quote: Please generate an explanation of why a video is funny, given visual descriptions and dialogue (or monologue), and an audio description for the video.
answer_1.outputs: Text explanations of humor in videos

answer_2.quote: we evaluate explanations using two model-based scores: SentBERT Score and ROSCOE.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we employ 10 AMT workers using the same criteria as in the dataset annotation...
answer_4.guideline: Workers rate each explanation on a scale from No (0) to Yes (1) and compare pairs to choose the better explanation.
